components.name: Fan
components.note: Live WebGL render (three.js) of the holographic LED fan: black hub, two LED blades spinning at 700 rpm, clear cover ring, drawn by code at runtime over the room photograph; the user asked for the same spinner as the live holo site, not a static fan.

components.name: Hologram
components.note: The picture disc of the live WebGL fan: code renders the client's real hologram clip (Schaller Bros liquor, Zona Donut, juice logo, Aqua phone case) through the persistence-of-vision shader at this box, swapping with the niche tabs; the user chose 'My real client videos' over the comp's placeholder bottle.

components.name: Leader rotor
components.note: Thin white callout rule with a small round end dot: from the right blade up to the right, then horizontal to the Two-blade rotor label; code draws it with CSS borders.

components.name: Leader cover
components.note: Thin white callout rule with a small round end dot: from the Clear acrylic cover label right, then up to the edge of the cover disc; code draws it with CSS borders.

components.name: Hero environment
components.note: Photograph of a dim back bar at night, bottles on amber-lit shelves, out of focus and darkened; the empty room behind the fan, filling the whole hero behind nav, headline and tabs. Swaps per niche in the build; the fan itself is rendered live in WebGL on top.
